title: How researchers debunked ‘race science’: ‘a triumph of scientific self-correction’
title_zh: 研究人员如何驳斥“种族科学”：科学自我纠错的胜利
abstract: An account of how nineteenth-century studies aiming to find a biological basis for human races were dismantled by good scientific practices — although their effects are still felt today.
abstract_zh: 讲述了十九世纪旨在寻找人类种族生物学基础的研究是如何被良好的科学实践推翻的，尽管其影响至今仍在。
